request: DebugAI live role execution mode, gate health and app sidecar images, read-only after Host transport recovery; zero model inference

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
p=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai
printf 'SOURCE_HEAD='; git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD
printf 'SOURCE_BRANCH='; git -C "$p" branch --show-current
printf 'SOURCE_DIRTY='; if test -z "$(git -C "$p" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"; then echo NO; else echo YES; fi
for c in debug-ai-debug-ai-1 debug-ai-sandbox-runner-1; do
  echo "CONTAINER=$c"
  docker inspect --format 'STATE={{.State.Status}} IMAGE={{.Image}}' "$c"
done
echo DEBUGAI_RUNTIME_FLAGS_BEGIN
docker inspect --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' debug-ai-debug-ai-1 | awk -F= '$1=="DEBUG_AI_ROLE_EXECUTION_MODE" || $1=="DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_DISPATCH_MODE" || $1=="DEBUG_AI_CORE_CONTEXT_TOKENS" {print $1 "=" $2}'
echo DEBUGAI_RUNTIME_FLAGS_END
for port in 8787 18181 18182 18183 18184; do
  code=$(curl --max-time 3 -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:$port/health" 2>/dev/null || true)
  printf 'HEALTH_%s=%s\n' "$port" "${code:-UNKNOWN}"
done
